entries.title: Joshua 12:1
segments: ¶Now these are the kings of the land whom the children of Israel overcame, taking as their heritage their land on the east side of Jordan, from the valley of the Arnon to Mount Hermon, and all the Arabah to the east:

entries.title: Joshua 12:2
segments: Sihon, king of the Amorites, who was living in Heshbon, ruling from Aroer, which is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, and the town in the middle of the valley, and half Gilead, as far as the river Jabbok, the limits of the children of Ammon;

entries.title: Joshua 12:3
segments: And the Arabah to the sea of Chinneroth, to the east, and to the sea of the Arabah, that is the Salt Sea, to the east, the way to Beth-jeshimoth; and on the south, under the slopes of Pisgah:

entries.title: Joshua 12:4
segments: And the land of Og, king of Bashan, of the rest of the Rephaim, who was living at Ashtaroth and at Edrei,

entries.title: Joshua 12:5
segments: Ruling in the mountain of Hermon, and in Salecah, and in all Bashan, as far as the limits of the Geshurites and the Maacathites, and half Gilead, to the land of Sihon, king of Heshbon.

entries.title: Joshua 12:6
segments: Moses, the servant of the Lord, and the children of Israel overcame them; and Moses, the servant of the Lord, gave their land for a heritage to the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh.

entries.title: Joshua 12:7
segments: ¶And these are the kings of the land whom Joshua and the children of Israel overcame on the west side of Jordan, from Baal-gad in the valley of Lebanon to Mount Halak, which goes up to Seir; and Joshua gave the land to the tribes of Israel for a heritage, in keeping with their divisions;

entries.title: Joshua 12:8
segments: In the hill-country, and in the lowland, and in the Arabah, and on the mountain slopes, and in the waste land, and in the South; the Hittites, the Amorites, and the Canaanites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites.

entries.title: Joshua 12:9
segments: The king of Jericho, one; the king of Ai, which is near Beth-el, one;

entries.title: Joshua 12:10
segments: The king of Jerusalem, one; the king of Hebron, one;

entries.title: Joshua 12:11
segments: The king of Jarmuth, one; the king of Lachish, one;

entries.title: Joshua 12:12
segments: The king of Eglon, one; the king of Gezer, one;

entries.title: Joshua 12:13
segments: The king of Debir, one; the king of Geder, one;

entries.title: Joshua 12:14
segments: The king of Hormah, one; the king of Arad, one;

entries.title: Joshua 12:15
segments: The king of Libnah, one; the king of Adullam, one;

entries.title: Joshua 12:16
segments: The king of Makkedah, one; the king of Beth-el, one;

entries.title: Joshua 12:17
segments: The king of Tappuah, one; the king of Hepher, one;

entries.title: Joshua 12:18
segments: The king of Aphek, one; the king of Lassharon, one;

entries.title: Joshua 12:19
segments: The king of Madon, one; the king of Hazor, one;

entries.title: Joshua 12:20
segments: The king of Shimron-meron, one; the king of Achshaph, one;

entries.title: Joshua 12:21
segments: The king of Taanach, one; the king of Megiddo, one;

entries.title: Joshua 12:22
segments: The king of Kedesh, one; the king of Jokneam in Carmel, one;

entries.title: Joshua 12:23
segments: The king of Dor on the hill of Dor, one; the king of Goiim in Gilgal, one;

entries.title: Joshua 12:24
segments: The king of Tirzah, one; all the kings together were thirty-one.
